We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied some templates but not all. Need to construct a route JSON where each reaction uses the specified template ID in order, starting from target molecule and moving backward to precursors.

We need to ensure each step yields precursors that are further processed by next template.

We have target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of three strings? It returned something like "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors. Choose one that can be further processed by template 1914389.

We tried applying 1914389 to some of those, got some results for the one with OSi group? The first attempt with "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" gave result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So two precursors: one is a deprotected version with CC=O, still with Si protecting group; the other is some ester? Actually second is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That seems like a separate fragment maybe from cleavage.

We need to follow the order: after 29646, we apply 1914389 to each product? The route must be linear? Probably each reaction step transforms a molecule into precursors; we need to produce a tree where each reaction's children are the precursors. Use the given order.

Thus step1: target -> using template 29646 -> produce precursor A (choose one). Step2: apply template 1914389 to precursor A -> produce precursors B1 and B2. Step3: apply template 1914390 to each of those? Actually order says next template is 1914390. So we need to apply 1914390 to each precursor from previous step (or maybe to one of them). Continue.

We need to find applicable matches. We have template 1914390 applied to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" gave product "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That's a precursor.

We also have template 149040 applied to that gave nothing. Maybe need to apply 149040 to something else.

We also have template 1914391 not yet used. Need to get its effect. Let's get its SMARTS to understand.
